C_azr_maya.name: Maya Serrano
C_azr_maya.text: MAYA SERRANO — POV anchor and Brine Squad competence center. Dark navy technical uniform, radio harness / utility belt / practical tools, functional dark hair, serious slightly tired expression, contained posture. Competent first, pretty second. Never style her like Guest Relations or a Finfluencer.

C_azr_julian.name: Julian Heatherington
C_azr_julian.text: JULIAN HEATHERINGTON — Finfluencer content lead. Branded azure on-camera uniform with hot-pink accents, polished attractive presentation, easy grin, phone / mic / content gear, posture that assumes the camera should already be on him. Charming and overconfident, not cruel.

C_azr_fleur.name: Fleur Fontaine
C_azr_fleur.text: FLEUR FONTAINE — Finfluencer creative director. Branded azure plus hot-pink, elegant and highly camera-ready, poised expressive silhouette, intentional visual polish. Glamour that is irritatingly useful; never merge her wardrobe language with Brine Squad or Guest Relations.

C_azr_pip.name: Pip O'Mally
C_azr_pip.text: PIP O'MALLY — Guest Relations translator under pressure. Lighter blue / teal hospitality uniform, tablet, visitor-facing badge, headset or small radio, warm open expression, animated posture and customer-service smile under stress. Must not share Maya's hairstyle, face, dark uniform, props or body language.

C_azr_elliot.name: Elliot
C_azr_elliot.text: ELLIOT — compliance, standards and brand-integrity pressure. Keep design institutionally credible and distinct from the four core group silhouettes; no invented gimmick should overpower the standards/compliance function.

C_azr_raf.name: Raf
C_azr_raf.text: RAF — food-service and hospitality pressure with room for earned competence. Keep design grounded in Azure Reach's polished public institution rather than industrial or slapstick caricature styling.

C_azr_nia.name: Nia
C_azr_nia.text: NIA — front-of-house calm, ticketing, accessibility and de-escalation competence. Guest-facing presentation should read clean, approachable and socially capable without duplicating Pip's exact silhouette.

C_azr_beatrice.name: Beatrice
C_azr_beatrice.text: BEATRICE — Corporate / Management pressure with real competence. Tailored pale-blue or executive-toned suit, polished expensive presentation, upright controlled posture, minimal accessories. Sponsor-meeting authority without villain coding.

C_azr_sal.name: Sal
C_azr_sal.text: SAL — Brine Squad operations veteran. Dark practical ops uniform, sturdy worn-in silhouette, practical boots, tool case or maintenance bag when relevant, dry expression, no hot pink. Looks like the adult who has already seen this problem twice.

C_azr_dora.name: Dora
C_azr_dora.text: DORA — animal-welfare moral center. Visual treatment must reinforce credible animal-care authority without turning welfare into melodrama; animals remain calm and safe around her work.

C_azr_kyler.name: Kyler Chen
C_azr_kyler.text: KYLER CHEN — Finfluencer-adjacent media support. May share restrained hot-pink brand accents but must read as support rather than star; tablet, camera, phone rig or media gear, bright-eyed enthusiastic posture, plugged into metrics and content rhythms.
